model.chaining: Adler convention: on_hit on a connected Vile Ash packet schedules tick k+1 via the shared queue. No new ContentEvent variant. A per-target train {generation, stacks, next_tick_us, deadline_us} provides the stale-tick guard: a tick chains only if its time equals train.next_tick_us.
model.lifecycle: A defeated source stops the train; an off-field source keeps ticking (no active-actor check). Targets are the scenario's living targets at cast ('large area' spread).
model.ownership: crates/content/src/characters/zankou/vile_ash.rs; State.vile_ash_trains: BTreeMap<usize, VileAshTrain>; skill.rs on_cast (UltraSkill) -> apply_vile_ash; skill.rs on_hit -> continue_dot_train for Vile Ash packets. Hypothesis id: character.zankou.vile_ash_dot_scheduling_v1.
model.producer: GA_Zankou_UltraSkill applies 5 Vile Ash stacks per living target, capped at 10 (Bloodfeast Reverie: 5 stacks, guide_zankou.json).
model.refresh: Re-cast adds 5 stacks (cap 10), replaces the deadline (hit_time + 30s) and bumps the generation. At most one already-queued stale tick settles with its snapshot and does not chain.
model.scheduling: First tick at hit_time + 1s, then every 1s while tick_time <= hit_time + 30s: 30 ticks per application. Each tick is a native GE_Player_Zankou_DotUltraDamage HitDelivery (NativeDirect binding, GAName GA_Zankou_UltraSkill) carrying State.Damage.Dot, so gear hooks observe live packets.
model.stack_coefficient: calc_zankou_dot_stack_coef(effect_id, expand_multiplier, stacks): exact Vile Ash class set {GE_Player_Zankou_DotDamage, GE_Player_Zankou_DotUltraDamage}; expand_multiplier > 0 -> 0; else clamp(stacks - 1, 0, 10). Matches all 7 frozen Calc_ZankouDotStackCoef probes.
model.tick_coefficient: k_tick = k_native * (1 + additional), where k_native = 0.015 at array_index 0 (DT_SkillDamageData AtkRateBaseArray[0]) and additional = calc_zankou_dot_stack_coef(...). This is the damage-and-stat-zones §2 relative coefficient form; it is NOT k_native * stacks * (1 + additional) (double-apply rejected by the evidence card).
